items.q: Where do I check if the loader is current?
items.a: Read cheats-valorant.org after a VALORANT or Vanguard update. A banner from yesterday is not a current build. Leave the loader closed until the page matches this client.

items.q: A big VALORANT update just dropped. When do I open the loader?
items.a: Read the status page after that client build, and after every hotfix, before you launch. A saved config from an older build is not a current check. A ban is still possible.
items.aHtml: Read the status page after that client build, and after every hotfix, before you launch. A saved config from an older build is not a current check. A ban is still possible.

items.q: Will a game patch change the loader menu overnight?
items.a: Game updates can shift maps, modes, and balance. The loader group names on the cheat product page are the reference—read the status note after each client or Vanguard update before you assume your saved preset still matches.
items.aHtml: Game updates can shift maps, modes, and balance. The loader group names on the cheat product page are the reference—read the status page after each client or Vanguard update before you assume your saved preset still matches.

items.q: What happens after I buy?
items.a: Checkout opens the portal with the loader for the product you paid for. Save a config after you tune it. HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot stay on.

items.q: Can I get banned?
items.a: Yes. Vanguard can act on the account. Nothing on this site is a guarantee that a session stays clean.

items.q: What is an HWID flag, and does the cheat key fix it?
items.a: A hardware flag follows the PC. New accounts can fail on that machine and work on another. That is the HWID Spoofer, sold separately. It does not undo an account-only restriction, and lifetime on the menu does not include it.

items.q: Which PCs are supported?
items.a: Windows 10 or 11 on Intel or AMD, with HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot on. macOS and Linux are not supported.

items.q: Can I move a key to another PC?
items.a: Open support with the order email. A machine that fails new accounts is an HWID Spoofer purchase, not a free move of the cheat key.

items.q: What is for sale?
items.a: the menu and the HWID Spoofer are listed on the products page. The menu is $35 for 31 days or $150 lifetime. The HWID spoofer is $50 for 31 days or $150 lifetime. They are separate checkouts.

items.q: Does $150 lifetime include the spoofer?
items.a: No. Lifetime on VALORANT cheats is that product only. The HWID spoofer is a separate key with its own $50 and $150 plans. A shorter plan does not promise a credit toward lifetime.

items.q: What does Customizable FOV change?
items.a: FOV under Aimbot Options sets how wide the aim cone is. Pair it with Smoothness, Speed, and Stickiness before you raise Draw FOV on stream.

items.q: Why does player ESP cover the fight?
items.a: Player Visual Options includes health bar, shield bar, agent, rank, box, snapline, skeleton, head circle, equip name, level, and distance. Turn off labels you do not read, or lower Max Distance.

items.q: Is this a DMA card?
items.a: No. VALORANT cheats is a Windows loader from checkout. A DMA device is a different product and is not what this key delivers. Do not run a file that arrived from a search result.

items.q: When is the HWID spoofer the right buy?
items.a: Use HWID Spoofer when a new account fails on one PC and works on another. It does not fix an account-only restriction on the same machine.

items.q: Where do I save the menu after I change it?
items.a: Misc Options includes Create/Save/Load/Unload Config. Save after you tune Aimbot Options, Player Visual Options, and World Visual Options.

items.q: Can the aimbot ignore downed players?
items.a: Visible Check sits in Aimbot Options with Aimbot Filter and Aimbot Bone. Each is a separate toggle in that group.

items.q: What does Select Custom Hitbox do?
items.a: Aimbot Bone under Aimbot Options picks which bone the assist prefers. Pair it with FOV, Smoothness, Speed, and Stickiness for your preset.

items.q: What is in World Visual Options?
items.a: World Visual Options covers abilities, traps, spike defuse progress and time, per-character customization, and distance caps. Each category has its own toggle.

items.q: Does the menu include a controller bind?
items.a: Combat Mode Hotkey in Misc Options hides ability and trap ESP while held. Aimbot Options is separate: Enable Aimbot, FOV, smoothness, and draw overlays.

items.q: How do I mark a player without every label?
items.a: Player Visual Options includes box, snapline, skeleton, head circle, agent, rank, equip name, level, and distance. Lower Max Distance if the fight looks crowded.

items.q: How do item labels work?
items.a: World Visual Options lists abilities, traps, and spike cues with Show Icon and Show Distance toggles. Font Size lives under Misc Options.

items.q: Where are the crosshair and FOV draw toggles?
items.a: Draw FOV and Draw Target Line are under Aimbot Options with Enable Aimbot and Visible Check.

items.q: Does item ESP turn the aimbot off?
items.a: Combat Mode Hotkey in Misc Options hides ability and trap ESP. Enable Aimbot in Aimbot Options is separate.

items.q: What is in Custom Key Binds?
items.a: Menu open, aim holds, head switch, and toggles for players, radar, and items. Color Options and Config Options are separate groups.

items.q: Are blog guides official product documentation?
items.a: Articles explain workflows and link to the menu. The feature list on that page is the checkout source of truth.

items.q: Need help applying this guide?
items.a: Open support with your order email and the article title. Include the exact loader text if something fails.

items.q: Will settings in this article work next patch?
items.a: Re-check after every VALORANT or Vanguard update. Reload a saved config instead of copying old slider values from a post.

items.q: Which plan should I start with?
items.a: Start with the 31-day key if you want to try one product before paying once. The menu is $35 for 31 days or $150 lifetime. The HWID spoofer is $50 for 31 days or $150 lifetime. A shorter plan does not include a credit toward lifetime, and a lifetime key on one product does not include the others.

items.q: Can I upgrade a 31-day key to lifetime?
items.a: There is no automatic upgrade. Lifetime is a separate checkout on the same product. The $35 or $50 you already paid is not credited toward the $150 lifetime price.

items.q: What happens when a plan expires?
items.a: A 31-day key stops when that period ends. Buy another 31-day key or a lifetime key on that same product to keep access. Lifetime does not renew. An expired key does not move to a different product.

items.q: Where do I check the current loader status?
items.a: Read the status page before you launch. Updated means the note was refreshed. It is not a claim that a session stays clean.

paragraphs: 用于 VALORANT 的第三方工具可能会与游戏更新及 Vanguard 发生冲突。您使用本软件的风险自负，包括可能面临账号处理风险。
每次游戏前请查看主页状态横幅。在补丁更新后模块离线或未对齐时，请勿登录您的主服务器。

sections.heading: 更改
paragraphs: 我们可能会更新这些条款。更新时，顶部的“最后更新”日期将会更改。在更改后继续使用本网站即表示您接受修改后的条款。

sections.heading: 支持
paragraphs: 有关条款、账单或 loader 的问题，请使用“支持”页面上的按钮。另请参阅我们的隐私政策（Privacy Policy），了解我们如何处理网站数据。

updates.title: VCT 2027 竞技完整性框架
updates.summary: Riot 概述了公开赛事预选赛的 Vanguard 预检例程。在线队伍现在在比赛前面临更严格的软件层审查和后台进程检查。本商店不描述如何通过该审查。请在注意说明之后阅读此菜单的状态标签，并将锦标赛规则与普通排位赛分开对待。

updates.title: Vanguard 按需加载与 Windows 11 基线
updates.summary: 当 VALORANT 关闭时，Vanguard 按需模式可以保持关闭状态，但将其打开会强制执行更重的 Windows 11 基线：HVCI、VBS 和 TPM 2.0。这堵住了常见的注入器漏洞。在你加载所针对的构建版本上保持这些功能启用。本页不记录绕过步骤。

updates.title: 2026年5月22日 — 以 DMA 为中心的 Vanguard 更新
updates.summary: Riot 将目标锁定在外部 SATA/NVMe 直接内存访问设置及相关固件绕过上。公众讨论集中在 Windows IOMMU 和 DMA 重新映射以阻止恶意设备 DLL。Riot 表示合法硬件不会被物理破坏；违规的辅助 config 配置可能会在该 PC 上失效。本商店出售 Windows loader，而非 DMA 卡。博客文章“Vanguard 安全时间线 (2026)”总结了相同的日期。

updates.title: 状态标签
updates.summary: 绿色意味着此说明列出了当前要加载的文件。红色意味着请等待。在启动之前，请在 VALORANT 或 Vanguard 更新后阅读此页面。该标签并非关于免封禁的声明，也不意味着对局会保持干净。

updates.title: 菜单涵盖内容
updates.summary: 已发布的菜单列出了 Aimbot 选项、玩家视觉选项、世界视觉选项和杂项选项。战斗模式热键隐藏能力和陷阱 ESP。它不会消除 Vanguard 风险。

updates.title: PC 要求
updates.summary: Windows 10 或 11、Intel Core i5 或 AMD Ryzen 5 或更高版本，以及最新的 VALORANT PC 客户端。保持 HVCI、Core Isolation、TPM 和 Secure Boot 开启。

updates.title: “已更新”并非免封禁声明
updates.summary: 已更新意味着此说明已刷新。这并不意味着 loader 是免封禁的，也不意味着在下一次 Vanguard 或游戏更新后对局会保持干净。
